[ INTEL & METHODOLOGY FAQ ]

Monthly CPI index readings are retrieved from the United Nations Statistics Division. NBS remains the primary national publisher, but its food and core series are not yet connected here.

For supported comparable periods, the calculation uses Amount × (Target CPI ÷ Base CPI). Comparisons across the January 2025 series break are not made.

The connected UN series does not publish NBS food or core rates. We show them as unavailable rather than infer or copy figures from unrelated sources.
